Name: Main Controller
Description: Microcontroller for overall system control, sensor reading, and actuator activation.

Name: Soil Moisture Sensor
Description: Measures the volumetric water content in the soil.

Name: Ambient Temp/Humidity Sensor
Description: Measures ambient temperature and relative humidity of the air.

Name: Water Pump
Description: Pumps water from an external container to water the plants.

Name: Cooling Fan
Description: Circulates air to regulate ambient humidity and temperature.

Name: Pump Relay Module
Description: Controls the 12V water pump using a 5V signal from the ESP32.

Name: Fan Relay Module
Description: Controls the 12V cooling fan using a 5V signal from the ESP32.

Name: 5V Step-Down Converter
Description: Steps down 12V from the main power supply to 5V for the ESP32, sensors, and relays.

Name: Mini Greenhouse Frame
Description: Compact frame to house plants and internal components, providing a controlled environment.

Name: Electronics Enclosure
Description: Custom enclosure to protect ESP32, relays, and power converter from humidity and physical damage.

Name: Soil Sensor Mount
Description: Bracket to securely hold the capacitive soil moisture sensor in the soil at the desired depth.

Name: Ambient Sensor Mount
Description: Small mount for the DHT22 sensor to be positioned for accurate ambient readings.

Name: Water Pump Bracket
Description: Mounting bracket to secure the 12V DC water pump within the greenhouse or near the external reservoir.

Name: Cooling Fan Mount
Description: Bracket to integrate the 80mm cooling fan into the greenhouse structure for air circulation.

Name: M3 Screws
Description: Fasteners for mounting PCBs and components to 3D-printed parts and the greenhouse frame.

Name: M3 Heat Set Inserts
Description: Used in 3D-printed parts to provide strong, reusable threads for M3 screws.

Name: Water Tubing
Description: Flexible tubing for connecting the water pump to the external reservoir and to the plant area.

Name: Cable Zip Ties
Description: For organizing and securing wiring within the greenhouse.

Name: Solar Panel
Description: Converts sunlight into electrical energy to power the system and charge the battery.

Name: Solar Charge Controller
Description: Manages power flow from the solar panel to the battery and regulates output to the load.

Name: 12V Battery
Description: Stores energy from the solar panel for continuous power supply during low light or night.

Name: Solar Panel Mount
Description: Bracket to securely attach the solar panel to the greenhouse frame.

Name: Charge Controller Mount
Description: Mounting bracket to secure the solar charge controller inside the electronics enclosure.

Name: Battery Holder
Description: Tray or enclosure to securely hold the 12V battery.
